definitions.explanation: Describes a clean, decisive cut — like one sword stroke or a single snip — with no jagged edge or hesitation.
Figurative extension: making a clean break with a habit, a relationship, or a desire — quitting once and for all, without lingering attachment. The most common modern usage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{枝|えだ}→枝：02181_eda⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧すっぱり⟦{切|き}り{落|お}とした→切り落とす：28973_kiriotosu⟧。
examples.english: He lopped the branch off in one clean stroke.

examples.japanese: ⟦{包丁|ほうちょう}→包丁：04976_houchou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{切|き}れ{味|あじ}→切れ味：19110_kireaji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧、⟦トマト→トマト：05192_tomato⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧すっぱり⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}れた→切れる：01936_kireru⟧。
examples.english: The knife was sharp and cut the tomato cleanly in two.

examples.japanese: タバコ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧すっぱり⟦やめた→やめる：00909_yameru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧すっぱり⟦{別|わか}れた→別れる：01113_wakareru⟧。
examples.english: I made a clean break with him.

examples.japanese: ⟦{過去|かこ}→過去：00152_kako⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧すっぱり⟦{忘|わす}れて→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めよう→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: Let's put the past completely behind us and start a new life.

notes:
Most often used today with verbs of quitting or breaking off (⟦やめる→やめる：00909_yameru⟧, ⟦{別|わか}れる→別れる：01113_wakareru⟧, ⟦{忘|わす}れる→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧) to emphasize a decisive, no-residue break. Frequently appears with ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ as すっぱり⟦と→と：00512_to⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- すっぱり⟦やめる→やめる：00909_yameru⟧: to quit cleanly, for good
- すっぱり⟦{諦|あきら}める→諦める：01813_akirameru⟧: to give up completely
- すっぱり⟦{忘|わす}れる→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧: to put completely out of one's mind
- すっぱり⟦{別|わか}れる→別れる：01113_wakareru⟧: to make a clean break
- すっぱり⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: to cut cleanly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦きっぱり→きっぱり：06354_kippari⟧: flatly; firmly — focuses on the decisiveness of refusal or declaration
- スパッ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: in one clean stroke — very similar; also covers both cutting and quitting
- ⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: cleanly; neatly — broader, also covers tidiness, not just decisiveness
